# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.

- **PR #**: 1626
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1626
- **Title**: gh-1624 [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1624` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +489
- **Deletions**: -78
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T06:42:14Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T06:50:03Z

## PR Description

Closes #1624
### Root Cause

- gh-1570's binding preflight (`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) made a vendor-prefix dialect disagreement fatal on **any** endpoint. On translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api) the `vendor/` prefix is a routing key, not a dialect declaration — so `FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` + bifrost's `/anthropic` path + `zai/glm-5.3` exited 64 on every boot (1.0.576 regression).

### Fix

- `provider_model_binding.dart`: the vendor-prefix verdict is scoped to **known catalog endpoints**, mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule — real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) keep the gh-1570 fail-fast; unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a new `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` note instead of exit 64. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` renders the warnings on the FA_PROVIDER_* boot notice (`warning: binding — …`).
- Docs: `wire:` documented with its equal-kind caveat (override engages only when it differs from the record's own kind) in README (env preconfig), `docs/agents/providers.md` (§ Translating proxies), `--help`; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxy factories with the `wire:` migration.

### Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart`: new gh-1624 REG group — AC1 (unknown endpoint + mismatched prefix boots with warning), AC2 (same mismatch on known vendor endpoints still fatal; family verdict intact), AC3 (`wire:` != record kind skips the checks; `wire:` == kind does not; warnings are not identity).
- `test/cli/env_provider_preconfig_test.dart`: the incident `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` now parses with a binding warning; known-endpoint mismatch still dies at parse.
- `test/model_roles/bifrost_proxy_binding_test.dart` (new IT): a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (anthropic-dialect `/anthropic` path translating `zai/glm-5.3`) boots through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and completes a streamed request via the production `providerStreamFunction('anthropic', …)` — proxy saw `/anthropic/v1/messages`, `x-api-key`, and the translated model id.
- Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`): **10978 passed, 0 failed** (10 platform-locked skips).

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Additions**: +489

## PR Description

Closes #1624
### Root Cause

- gh-1570's binding preflight (`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) made a vendor-prefix dialect disagreement fatal on **any** endpoint. On translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api) the `vendor/` prefix is a routing key, not a dialect declaration — so `FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` + bifrost's `/anthropic` path + `zai/glm-5.3` exited 64 on every boot (1.0.576 regression).

### Fix

- `provider_model_binding.dart`: the vendor-prefix verdict is scoped to **known catalog endpoints**, mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule — real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) keep the gh-1570 fail-fast; unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a new `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` note instead of exit 64. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` renders the warnings on the FA_PROVIDER_* boot notice (`warning: binding — …`).
- Docs: `wire:` documented with its equal-kind caveat (override engages only when it differs from the record's own kind) in README (env preconfig), `docs/agents/providers.md` (§ Translating proxies), `--help`; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxy factories with the `wire:` migration.

### Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart`: new gh-1624 REG group — AC1 (unknown endpoint + mismatched prefix boots with warning), AC2 (same mismatch on known vendor endpoints still fatal; family verdict intact), AC3 (`wire:` != record kind skips the checks; `wire:` == kind does not; warnings are not identity).
- `test/cli/env_provider_preconfig_test.dart`: the incident `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` now parses with a binding warning; known-endpoint mismatch still dies at parse.
- `test/model_roles/bifrost_proxy_binding_test.dart` (new IT): a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (anthropic-dialect `/anthropic` path translating `zai/glm-5.3`) boots through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and completes a streamed request via the production `providerStreamFunction('anthropic', …)` — proxy saw `/anthropic/v1/messages`, `x-api-key`, and the translated model id.
- Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`): **10978 passed, 0 failed** (10 platform-locked skips).

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.

BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1626
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1626
- **Title**: gh-1624 [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1624` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +489
- **Deletions**: -78
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T06:42:14Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T06:50:03Z

## PR Description

Closes #1624
### Root Cause

- gh-1570's binding preflight (`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) made a vendor-prefix dialect disagreement fatal on **any** endpoint. On translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api) the `vendor/` prefix is a routing key, not a dialect declaration — so `FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` + bifrost's `/anthropic` path + `zai/glm-5.3` exited 64 on every boot (1.0.576 regression).

- `provider_model_binding.dart`: the vendor-prefix verdict is scoped to **known catalog endpoints**, mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule — real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) keep the gh-1570 fail-fast; unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a new `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` note instead of exit 64. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` renders the warnings on the FA_PROVIDER_* boot notice (`warning: binding — …`).

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

+## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)
+
+The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
+(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
+(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
+(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
+(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
+mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
+prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
+mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
+Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
+several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
+configuration since gh-1624.

+takes it as `wire:`) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks,
+overriding the provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages
+ONLY when the declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind —
+`record anthropic + wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks
+still run. The override silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller
+asserts the endpoint speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report
+(`wire override:`) so a silenced check is never invisible.

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

2. `lib/src/cli/startup.dart:338` and `startup.dart:371` — CLI flag paths. Warnings NOT rendered?

So the warnings are rendered only in `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (the runapp boot). Other entry points:

2. `lib/src/cli/startup.dart:371` (`_revalidatePartialOverride`) — resolves and discards the binding. If a warning arises here, it's dropped. This is the CLI flag path (`--model` / `--base-url` over restored/preconfigured binding). Warning dropped silently — the "loud" note never reaches the user on this path.
3. `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart:199` — queue entries resolve a binding; warnings dropped. Queue entries with private baseUrls will carry warnings that never get rendered. The PR description says "queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way" — so this path is affected by the fix but the warnings are silently dropped there.

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. # gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

+## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)
+
+The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
+(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
+(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
+(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
+(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
+mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
+prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
+mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
+Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
+several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
+configuration since gh-1624.
+
+`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key; `ProviderModelBinding.resolve`
+takes it as `wire:`) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks,
+overriding the provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages
+ONLY when the declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind —
+`record anthropic + wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks
+still run. The override silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller
+asserts the endpoint speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report
+(`wire override:`) so a silenced check is never invisible.
+
