# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

# Pull Request Information

- **Title**: gh-1624 [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1624` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +489
- **Deletions**: -78
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T06:42:14Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T06:50:03Z

## PR Description

Closes #1624
### Root Cause

- gh-1570's binding preflight (`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) made a vendor-prefix dialect disagreement fatal on **any** endpoint. On translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api) the `vendor/` prefix is a routing key, not a dialect declaration — so `FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` + bifrost's `/anthropic` path + `zai/glm-5.3` exited 64 on every boot (1.0.576 regression).

### Fix

- `provider_model_binding.dart`: the vendor-prefix verdict is scoped to **known catalog endpoints**, mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule — real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) keep the gh-1570 fail-fast; unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a new `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` note instead of exit 64. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` renders the warnings on the FA_PROVIDER_* boot notice (`warning: binding — …`).

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

## PR Description

Closes #1624
### Root Cause

- gh-1570's binding preflight (`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) made a vendor-prefix dialect disagreement fatal on **any** endpoint. On translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api) the `vendor/` prefix is a routing key, not a dialect declaration — so `FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` + bifrost's `/anthropic` path + `zai/glm-5.3` exited 64 on every boot (1.0.576 regression).

### Fix

- `provider_model_binding.dart`: the vendor-prefix verdict is scoped to **known catalog endpoints**, mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule — real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) keep the gh-1570 fail-fast; unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a new `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` note instead of exit 64. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` renders the warnings on the FA_PROVIDER_* boot notice (`warning: binding — …`).
- Docs: `wire:` documented with its equal-kind caveat (override engages only when it differs from the record's own kind) in README (env preconfig), `docs/agents/providers.md` (§ Translating proxies), `--help`; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxy factories with the `wire:` migration.

### Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart`: new gh-1624 REG group — AC1 (unknown endpoint + mismatched prefix boots with warning), AC2 (same mismatch on known vendor endpoints still fatal; family verdict intact), AC3 (`wire:` != record kind skips the checks; `wire:` == kind does not; warnings are not identity).
- `test/cli/env_provider_preconfig_test.dart`: the incident `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` now parses with a binding warning; known-endpoint mismatch still dies at parse.
- `test/model_roles/bifrost_proxy_binding_test.dart` (new IT): a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (anthropic-dialect `/anthropic` path translating `zai/glm-5.3`) boots through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and completes a streamed request via the production `providerStreamFunction('anthropic', …)` — proxy saw `/anthropic/v1/messages`, `x-api-key`, and the translated model id.
- Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`): **10978 passed, 0 failed** (10 platform-locked skips).

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.

## PR Description

Closes #1624
### Root Cause

- gh-1570's binding preflight (`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) made a vendor-prefix dialect disagreement fatal on **any** endpoint. On translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api) the `vendor/` prefix is a routing key, not a dialect declaration — so `FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` + bifrost's `/anthropic` path + `zai/glm-5.3` exited 64 on every boot (1.0.576 regression).

### Fix

- `provider_model_binding.dart`: the vendor-prefix verdict is scoped to **known catalog endpoints**, mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule — real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) keep the gh-1570 fail-fast; unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a new `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` note instead of exit 64. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` renders the warnings on the FA_PROVIDER_* boot notice (`warning: binding — …`).
- Docs: `wire:` documented with its equal-kind caveat (override engages only when it differs from the record's own kind) in README (env preconfig), `docs/agents/providers.md` (§ Translating proxies), `--help`; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxy factories with the `wire:` migration.

### Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart`: new gh-1624 REG group — AC1 (unknown endpoint + mismatched prefix boots with warning), AC2 (same mismatch on known vendor endpoints still fatal; family verdict intact), AC3 (`wire:` != record kind skips the checks; `wire:` == kind does not; warnings are not identity).
- `test/cli/env_provider_preconfig_test.dart`: the incident `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` now parses with a binding warning; known-endpoint mismatch still dies at parse.
- `test/model_roles/bifrost_proxy_binding_test.dart` (new IT): a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (anthropic-dialect `/anthropic` path translating `zai/glm-5.3`) boots through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and completes a streamed request via the production `providerStreamFunction('anthropic', …)` — proxy saw `/anthropic/v1/messages`, `x-api-key`, and the translated model id.
- Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`): **10978 passed, 0 failed** (10 platform-locked skips).

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

+## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)
+
+The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
+(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
+(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
+(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
+(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
+mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
+prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
+mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
+Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
+several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
+configuration since gh-1624.
+
+`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key; `ProviderModelBinding.resolve`
+takes it as `wire:`) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks,
+overriding the provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages
+ONLY when the declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind —
+`record anthropic + wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks
+still run. The override silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller
+asserts the endpoint speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report
+(`wire override:`) so a silenced check is never invisible.
+

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

+## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)
+
+The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
+(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
+(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
+(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
+(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
+mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
+prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
+mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
+Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
+several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
+configuration since gh-1624.
+
+`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key; `ProviderModelBinding.resolve`
+takes it as `wire:`) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks,
+overriding the provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages
+ONLY when the declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind —
+`record anthropic + wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks
+still run. The override silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller
+asserts the endpoint speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report
+(`wire override:`) so a silenced check is never invisible.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

+## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)
+
+The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
+(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
+(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
+(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
+(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
+mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
+prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
+mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
+Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
+several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
+configuration since gh-1624.
+
+`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key; `ProviderModelBinding.resolve`
+takes it as `wire:`) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks,
+overriding the provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages
+ONLY when the declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind —
+`record anthropic + wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks
+still run. The override silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller
+asserts the endpoint speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report
+(`wire override:`) so a silenced check is never invisible.
+

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Live-provider tag-boundary lint (gh-1199 AC2/AC3).

The merge-blocking Quality gate is deterministic-only: every test that
performs live provider I/O must carry the `llm` tag (and is then excluded
from every per-PR leg by `--exclude-tags llm` / shard_files.py
`--exclude-tag llm`). This lint makes the boundary self-enforcing: a test
file that LOOKS live fails the gate, so a new live test can never silently
join the gate again ("raz i navsegda").

Markers (comments stripped before matching; string literals are what
count — same discipline as shard_files.file_has_tag, with `https://`
spared inside literals):
    1. a real provider base URL as a string literal
       (openrouter.ai, anthropic.com, api.openai.com, openai.azure.com,
       generativelanguage.googleapis.com, api.groq.com, api.mistral.ai,
       api.deepseek.com, ollama.com, api.x.ai, api.cohere.ai,
       api.together.xyz, api.fireworks.ai, chatgpt.com, api.z.ai);
    2. a concrete provider credential env key as a string literal
       (OPENAI/OPENROUTER/ANTHROPIC/GOOGLE/GEMINI/OLLAMA/GROQ/MISTRAL/
       DEEPSEEK/GLM/ZAI/CODEGPT/COPILOT/CHATGPT/... + _API_KEY/_TOKEN/
       _SECRET/_CREDENTIALS) — only counts when the file shows no mock or
       loopback marker (`MockLlmServer`, `MockOpenAiServer`, `127.0.0.1`,
       `localhost`): injecting a dummy key to drive key resolution against
       a loopback mock is the standard deterministic pattern (see
       fa_cube_headless_helper.scrubbedChildEnv).

Scope (gh-1199 AC2): only files tagged `integration` WITHOUT the `llm`
tag are checked — those are the only files that can join the deterministic
integration gate (shard_files.py --tags integration). Unit suites never
carry secrets into their legs, so a key-naming unit fixture there cannot
flake the merge; flagging them would only pin noise. The `llm`-tagged
files are the audited `live` class; everything integration-tagged that
passes these markers is `mock` by construction.

A flagged file that is genuinely deterministic must be pinned in
AUDIT_MOCK below with a one-line justification; the list is part of the
PR review surface (gh-1199 AC3 — every entry is an audited `mock`
classification).

Scanned roots: test/, packages/*/test/, flutter_app/test/,
browser_ext/dart/test/.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on clean, 1 on any violation.

Run:
    python3 scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py
"""

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1626
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1626
- **Title**: gh-1624 [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1624` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +489
- **Deletions**: -78
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T06:42:14Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T06:50:03Z

## PR Description

Closes #1624
### Root Cause

- gh-1570's binding preflight (`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) made a vendor-prefix dialect disagreement fatal on **any** endpoint. On translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api) the `vendor/` prefix is a routing key, not a dialect declaration — so `FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` + bifrost's `/anthropic` path + `zai/glm-5.3` exited 64 on every boot (1.0.576 regression).

### Fix

- `provider_model_binding.dart`: the vendor-prefix verdict is scoped to **known catalog endpoints**, mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule — real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) keep the gh-1570 fail-fast; unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a new `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` note instead of exit 64. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` renders the warnings on the FA_PROVIDER_* boot notice (`warning: binding — …`).
- Docs: `wire:` documented with its equal-kind caveat (override engages only when it differs from the record's own kind) in README (env preconfig), `docs/agents/providers.md` (§ Translating proxies), `--help`; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxy factories with the `wire:` migration.

### Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart`: new gh-1624 REG group — AC1 (unknown endpoint + mismatched prefix boots with warning), AC2 (same mismatch on known vendor endpoints still fatal; family verdict intact), AC3 (`wire:` != record kind skips the checks; `wire:` == kind does not; warnings are not identity).
- `test/cli/env_provider_preconfig_test.dart`: the incident `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` now parses with a binding warning; known-endpoint mismatch still dies at parse.
- `test/model_roles/bifrost_proxy_binding_test.dart` (new IT): a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (anthropic-dialect `/anthropic` path translating `zai/glm-5.3`) boots through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and completes a streamed request via the production `providerStreamFunction('anthropic', …)` — proxy saw `/anthropic/v1/messages`, `x-api-key`, and the translated model id.
- Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`): **10978 passed, 0 failed** (10 platform-locked skips).

### Notes

- The family-exclusive check already passed unknown endpoints (unchanged); queue entries with explicit private baseUrls stop exit-64ing the same way. `wire:` remains a `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`-level key — now documented with the equal-kind caveat.

# gh-1624: [BUG][REG] gh-1570 binding preflight kills translating-proxy factories: vendor-prefix dialect check fatal on unknown endpoints (fa 1.0.576 exit 64)

## Description

## Symptom

After upgrading the factory image to fa **1.0.576**, every agent job dies **exit 64 before the agent starts**:

```
fa: provider/model binding mismatch: model "zai/glm-5.3" (dialect openai-completions)
but the binding serves "[...]-messages" on http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic
```

The same binding on fa 1.0.522 worked silently (zai model through bifrost's anthropic endpoint — a **translating proxy**). This is a full factory stop (every job needs the agent).

## What merged

PR **#1571** (gh-1570 ProviderModelBinding), commit `026525b121`, merged 2026-10-14 — boot-time binding preflight: model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint validation that throws `ConfigException` → exit 64 (fail-fast by design).

## Root cause

`_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`: for a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal — regardless of the endpoint**. Contrast the sibling check `_validateWireEndpoint`, which deliberately passes **unknown endpoints** ("there is nothing declared to check against").

The gap: bifrost (and LiteLLM/one-api-style gateways) are **translating proxies** — a single host serves multiple dialect paths (`/anthropic`, `/v1`, …) and `vendor/model` prefixes are routing keys, not dialect declarations. On such endpoints the vendor-prefix heuristic is a false positive; only the *real* vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com etc.) carry a verdict.

## Escape hatch that exists today (undocumented for this path)

`wire:` override: in the binding parser, `override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind` — when the declared `wire:` differs from the provider record's own kind, **both preflight checks are skipped** (`if (!override)`), restoring exactly the 1.0.522 behavior. The error text mentions it, but it is not documented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and silently does nothing when `wire:` equals the record's own kind (e.g. record `anthropic` + `wire: anthropic` ⇒ checks still fire).

## Immediate unblock for the factory (no image rollback)

In `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`, declare the bifrost binding as a **custom provider record** (any name ≠ `anthropic`, `apiType: anthropic`, `baseUrl: http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) **plus `wire: anthropic`**. The `wire:` differs from the record's own kind ⇒ preflight skipped ⇒ anthropic-wire requests to bifrost's `/anthropic` path, translated to the zai backend — the exact 1.0.522 behavior.

## Fix direction

1. Scope the vendor-prefix check (`_validateModelEndpoint` prefix branch) and the family-exclusive check to **known catalog endpoints** — mirror `_validateWireEndpoint`'s "unknown endpoints pass" rule. Private/proxy endpoints get a **warning**, never exit 64.
2. Fail-fast stays for real vendor endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is the gh-1570 value.
3. Document `wire:` in the FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG / roles docs **with the equal-kind caveat** (override engages only when `wire:` differs from the record's kind) — today it is a footgun.
4. Upgrade note in the release notes: gh-1570 is a **breaking change for proxy factories**; migration = `wire:` override.

## Acceptance

- **AC1** — vendor-prefixed model on an **unknown/private endpoint** with a mismatched binding dialect: boots with a warning (was: exit 64). UT with a fabricated binding.
- **AC2** — same mismatch on a **known vendor endpoint** (e.g. `claude-*` model on api.openai.com): still rejected (gh-1570 preserved). UT.
- **AC3** — `wire:` override with `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks (existing behavior, pin with a test); `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT skip (document + test the caveat).
- **AC4** — IT: bifrost-shaped fake proxy (anthropic-dialect path translating a `vendor/model` id) boots and completes a request on 1.0.576+.
- **AC5** — docs: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG/roles reference documents `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration; CHANGELOG entry marks gh-1570 breaking for proxies.

## Regression guard

REG test: the AC1/AC2 matrix runs on every PR touching `provider_model_binding.dart`; red blocks merge.

Assignee: ai-teammate. Refs: #1571, #1570.
